name: Carajam
description: Carajam was a desert planet in the Carajam system in the Dalonbian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The bounty hunter Boba Fett visited the planet to claim a bounty on a Rebel pilot, taking a job to target Zingo Gabnit.
